Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “the city where the author died” as Rome rather than Vatican City, asserting that the relevant office was the Governor of Rome. This redirected the search toward Rome’s governorship instead of the Governor of Vatican City State, whose post ended in 1952. This misclassification of the target city would lead to the wrong end year.
